long_biography.plain_text:
Martin Bouygues joined the family company as a works supervisor. He later created a catalogue-home subsidiary, joined the board and succeeded to the combined chairman-and-chief-executive role. During his tenure the group developed further in media, established a mobile-telecommunications arm and added energy and services.

Bouygues separated oversight from executive management after his long period at the helm. Martin now chairs the board and SCDM; Olivier Roussat is chief executive, while Olivier Bouygues remains a director. The core shareholding belongs to SCDM, which is controlled by Martin, Olivier Bouygues and their families. That structure combines inherited ownership with Martin's documented record as an operator, without making the family holding his alone.
